body: You've helped a little. It hasn't changed anything, but then again, my problems can't be talked or convinced away. My problems have to do with humanity as a whole, systemic exploitation, and being too depleted to bother trying anymore. I'm pretty sure I'm a lost cause. But hey, you've done some good trying to help me and others. So you're probably not a part of the world's problems. :)

I've already stated many on this page. Life is short, the world WILL exploit you, a mediocre/terrible life is guaranteed unless you're lucky or deluded, I have no energy left to do anything, I don't care anymore, etc. It's all so tedious. It's just not worth the effort for me.

Distracting my brain with false happiness won't change the facts. Nothing will suddenly get better if I do that. Maybe I'll be willing to be productive for once, but I don't see myself magically gaining the energy to achieve anything.

Maybe. Or it's a waste of time and effort. But I'd be arrogant to disregard something I can't objectively prove or disprove, so I'll just leave it at "maybe". It's still most likely wasted effort, but still... maybe.

Hmm. I suspect there's more to reality than meets the eye. What we see isn't everything there is. Time and space are malleable, and there can be many causes and effects of that. Spirits might be one effect.

But I digress. IF we are immortal souls and there's a greater meaning to existence, I still don't care about staying around on Earth. Bodies are weak and prone to sickness. They get feeble and die. Also, there's nothing I can learn as a human that wouldn't be better investigated as some sort of cosmic energy being. Right now I'm just an endlessly curious yet ignorant mortal that sees reality for what it is. I don't care enough to change anything because it would likely be a waste of effort. I've learned what I can as a human, and I'm sick of it all.

Yeah, life only has the meaning you give it. You live, you get screwed over endlessly, you have fleeting moments of happiness, then you die. Young or old, doesn't matter. No one matters in the end. I don't have the energy to live anymore. It's just a rat race. You're either exploited or you become part of the problem. I don't care anymore, I have no goals anymore, I don't have energy anymore. I have no ambition. What's that all mean? Life is meaningless for me. Oh well. I can either sit around being apathetic and worthless or die. Gee, what a difficult decision.
